query: SELECT s.data FROM state_index i JOIN states s USING(owner,subject,namespace,scope,concept) WHERE i.owner=? AND i.subject=? AND i.namespace=? AND i.scope=? AND i.known=1 ORDER BY i.magnitude DESC,i.basis_rank,i.confirmed_at DESC,i.concept LIMIT ?
plan: SEARCH i USING COVERING INDEX state_rank (owner=? AND subject=? AND namespace=? AND scope=? AND known=?)
SEARCH s USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_states_1 (owner=? AND subject=? AND namespace=? AND scope=? AND concept=?)
